# Reasons that interrupt as their table entry says: every reason in the
# reason tables (internal/detection/reason_table_*.go) is either listed
# here or marked trial() in its entry, never both. The test
# TestEveryReasonDeclaresItsTrialStatus enforces it, so a new reason
# cannot skip its trial by accident.
#
# A new reason starts with trial(): its findings wait for the digest
# for one release. Promotion is explicit: after a release on real
# clusters, remove trial() from the entry and add the reason to the
# "Promoted" section below with the release it graduated in.
# See docs/contributing-detector.md.

# Released in v1.2.0 or before.
